description: A bare false key in a static map is the string false
notes: The spec makes a bare identifier key a literal name, but in expressions false is the keyword for the bool false, and a keyword's role supersedes other interpretations. A static map doesn't convert keys to strings, so the two readings give the string "false" or the bool false. hashicorp/hcl gives the string: ObjectConsKeyExpr.Value names the key with hcl.ExprAsKeyword, and LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal turns the false literal back into its name (hclsyntax/expression.go).
